{"runnable": true, "why": "Prints different kinds of scalars with get/show: an integer of 4400 digits (over Python's 4300-digit str() limit, the handling one implementation removed), a float written in exponent form, negative infinity, a hex integer and a null written as ~; this shows whether each prints Python repr/str forms with lower-case null and one trailing newline, or fails.", "files": {".troupe/troupe.yml": "big: \nf: 1e3\nninf: -.inf\nhex: 0x1F\nn: ~\n", "agents/x.txt": "unused\n"}, "commands": [{"args": ["config", "get", "big"], "env": {"TROUPE_ACTOR": "human:owner"}}, {"args": ["config", "show", "f"], "env": {"TROUPE_ACTOR": "human:owner"}}, {"args": ["config", "get", "ninf"], "env": {"TROUPE_ACTOR": "human:owner"}}, {"args": ["config", "get", "hex"], "env": {"TROUPE_ACTOR": "human:owner"}}, {"args": ["config", "get", "n"], "env": {"TROUPE_ACTOR": "human:owner"}}], "show": [".troupe/troupe.yml"]}
